notes.title: New VR Adventure Game Release!
notes.content:
Hello VR Fans,

We’re excited to share our new adventure game, Tomb Explorer VR! If you're interested in this exciting VR title, mark your calendars for the August 1 release. Check out our trailer, screenshots below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/0b9808660bde17c78d0da579bfb9f53afa48b5f5.jpg[/img]

[b]TOMB EXPLORER VR[/b]

Tomb Explorer VR is an adventure game where you navigate/explore ancient ruins and tombs in search of historical treasures, relics and artifacts.

Features:
In a fully immersive physical virtual reality experience, you will need to utilize various physical movements such as walking, crouching, jumping, climbing, dodging, sliding, rope zip lining, and even using a whip to hang over ledges to navigate through each unique environment. The ultimate goal is to solve puzzles, unlock ancient mechanisms, avoid dangerous traps, and discover hidden passages to obtain valuable artifacts located all around the globe.

Experience real-life physical interactions in VR, using your hands, body movement, and weapons to crouch, jump, climb and navigate through different environments. Overcome various ancient traps that hinder you from completing your objective. Use your problem-solving skills to solve puzzles and explore new areas. Each unique environment comes with a historical background story.

notes.title: Asylum DLC Development Update 1
notes.content:
Welcome to the Asylum Development Progress Updates.
Today we reveal some media and the story behind the Asylum DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/618f5e6f648e30a9b934455aec14e00deafa70cc.jpg[/img]

During the events on Halloween night in SinisterHalloween® this all-new mental asylum chapter sends you into a new area within Mountain Peaks. As a journalist, you receive a secret email from the local asylum and a little girl is reported lost trick or treating. You decide to investigate the area.

Enter the mental asylum, with years of experience seeking the truth, use your wits, nerve, and mental fortitude to uncover the horrifying secrets within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/dfaeb73a0960aa310fa8ddd375fada9ed589a2b3.jpg[/img]

The interior reception area. It seems the emergency power is on. Why is the main power off? Something is not right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/76a36e0b561c7ef92a3b86a08a35b3a2275a7e2b.png[/img]
Where did the reception clerk go?

We have completed level design for the majority of the experience and are currently finalizing lighting.
We are hoping you can provide feedback to influence the final product. Head on over to our discord, and leave a msg, comment, and suggestion in our asylum channel.  https://discord.gg/7GeY56b

DEVELOPING MAPS
